0022600110.text: Denver, which has not yet played a 2026-27 game, hosts a New Orleans team that is 0-1, sits ninth in the West, and is one game back in third place in the Southwest. The Nuggets won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 122-116 road win in New Orleans on 2026-01-13, and no games have been played yet in this season's series. Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are both out for Denver.
